selection: Every owner, hint, quantum, seed and loss is retained as aggregate elapsed time/request counts over three repetitions. Same-owner plain-prefetch and exact same-callback mixed comparisons retain paired ratios. Full rows, original/continued host provenance, compiler commands, PMU and setup receipts remain in immutable worker artifacts.
protocol: K30,85% primary target; set b24,map8 b23,map64/MM64 b20,MM8 b21. Two prespecified seeds x three repetitions,2^21 requests,512MiB conditioning,independent miss0/50,all-hit chains/mixed. Fresh scalar-populated immutable heap owners; full useful bags,all32 ordered heads,priming/admission/tails/physical drain timed. No cache residency,retained-reader,concurrent mutation or write performance inference.
decision: No universal winner. Stream128 generally preserves plain-prefetch throughput and x86 chain paths retain gains. MM64 independent still loses on every CPU; NEON MM chains also lose. Keep all losses and explicit hint/owner choices. Existing read encoding/layout unchanged; targeted reduction experiment remains separate.
replay: Recover each original and continuation job; run loom-native-results.py with the frozen continuation source and digest, then this script on the three audited reports.

continuation.scope: Each shape/seed/miss comparison uses one host and one job. The full matrix spans the original and continuation hosts. Imported-file copies and the runner coverage report do not supply provenance.
